ruling.recommended_action: Refer to Ryde Trust & Safety for human review of the harassment allegation; preserve the trip record and driver statement [F4]; contact the rider via RydeHELP to take a fuller account and remind her of the safety-report channel and 995 / commercial-insurance paths if she wishes to pursue it.
ruling.escalation_reason: Safety case (SAFE-1): rider alleges sexual/prophetic harassment and feeling unsafe in the vehicle. No in-app chat [F3]; only the driver's post-trip denial [F4]. Harassment allegations are not auto-adjudicable; refer to a human reviewer with the fact summary.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's post-trip statement that 'nothing inappropriate happened' is an unsworn denial by the party accused and contradicts the rider's harassment complaint; with no chat [F3], recording or other corroboration it cannot be treated as resolving the allegation.
